name: Shelby County, TN
findings: Shelby County has 3,991 nonprofit organizations. 1,425 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 1,093 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Shelby County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few housing organizations list membership
observations.text: 13 housing organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 28 would.
